transport images, a1 the DEEPSEEK profile that does not read images; every profile is KEYLESS). `resolve` cases run
resolveVisionProfile after the case's `sql` (on the main copy); `send` cases run sendVisionRequest against a profile
with the LLM provider mocked BELOW both sides (`provider.mode`: ok → the scripted answer; throw → a plain failure;
hang → never answers, so the request's own timeout fires), recording the params the provider was handed, the
`llm_logs` rows (REAL logLLMCall), the `[Vision]` lines and the result. The attachment is a 1x1 PNG, well under the
transport shrink's bounds on both sides (`shrunk: false`); `data: null` is the plugin-loads-it passthrough.
